// Element data compiled from PubChem periodic-table records via
// periodic-table-data 1.1.1 (MIT, https://github.com/sjf8203/periodic-table-data).
// Atomic weights and bulk properties are reference values, not a
// validation source. Verify against IUPAC/CIAAW and NIST before publication.

export type ElementBlock = "s" | "p" | "d" | "f";

export type ElementCategory =
  | "Alkali metal"
  | "Alkaline earth metal"
  | "Transition metal"
  | "Post-transition metal"
  | "Metalloid"
  | "Nonmetal"
  | "Halogen"
  | "Noble gas"
  | "Lanthanide"
  | "Actinide";

export type ChemicalElement = {
  number: number;
  symbol: string;
  name: string;
  /** Atomic mass in unified atomic mass units. */
  mass: number;
  /** True for a standard atomic weight; false for a representative isotope mass. */
  standardWeight: boolean;
  category: ElementCategory;
  block: ElementBlock;
  period: number;
  /** Group 1–18, or null for the f-block strips. */
  group: number | null;
  electronConfiguration: string;
  /** Pauling electronegativity. */
  electronegativity: number | null;
  /** Empirical atomic radius in picometres. */
  radiusPm: number | null;
  /** First ionization energy in electronvolts. */
  ionizationEv: number | null;
  /** Electron affinity in electronvolts. */
  affinityEv: number | null;
  /** Common oxidation states, as reported by the source. */
  oxidation: string | null;
  standardState: string;
  /** Melting point in kelvin. */
  meltK: number | null;
  /** Boiling point in kelvin. */
  boilK: number | null;
  /** Density in g/cm³ for condensed phases, g/L for gases. */
  density: number | null;
  densityUnit: "g/cm³" | "g/L" | null;
  /** Year discovered, or a string such as "Ancient". */
  discovered: string | null;
};
